visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women stand on an urban sidewalk under a building overhang next to a row of parked bicycles. One wears a beige lace top, light jeans, and a black baseball cap, holding a white cake box. The other, with curly dark hair and a striped shirt, helps steady the box. (2) Inside a modern elevator, the camera focuses on a hand using a pink plastic lighter to ignite a question-mark-shaped candle on top of a white cake. The cake is decorated with colorful candy shards and a small circular 'Happy Birthday' tag. The lighting is bright. (3) The group enters a bright apartment living room. The main character, a woman in light grey pajamas and glasses, stands holding her smartphone with a shocked facial expression. She covers her mouth with her hand as she sees the birthday surprise. (4) The group celebrates together in the living room area. The birthday girl, still in her pajamas, laughs and talks animatedly with her friends. A small white Maltese dog is present. The background features colorful pastel balloons, a white sofa, and a floral patterned wall. (5) The birthday girl sits on the floor near a low white table with her dog. She closes her eyes and clasps her hands to make three wishes before blowing out the pink candle. Friends are seen in the periphery. She then uses a server to cut the cake.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Two female voices speak casually in Traditional Chinese while walking outdoors. Their tone is friendly and rhythmic. A low-tempo electronic pop BGM track plays in the background, mixed with distant urban environmental floor noise. (2) A sharp, metallic clicking sound occurs as a lighter is flicked repeatedly inside a reverberant elevator cabin. The female voices drop to a conspiratorial whisper, increasing spectral tension. The BGM continues steadily at a low amplitude. (3) The sound of a heavy door opening is followed immediately by a dense burst of high-arousal female voices singing 'Happy Birthday'. The primary speaker reacts with a sharp, high-pitched gasp and breathy laughter, indicating shock and joy. (4) A sequence of animated dialogue ensues. Multiple voices overlap with frequent laughter and teasing inflections. The BGM remains upbeat. Incidental sounds of clothing rustle and metallic thuds are audible as they move around the room. (5) The vocal intensity lowers significantly as the main character recites her birthday wishes in a calm, sincere professional narrative tone. The BGM volume ducks slightly to favor her speech clarity. (6) A sharp, high-velocity air burst SFX marks the blowing out of the candle, followed by mid-frequency clapping and high-arousal cheering. A faint percussive sound of a cake server signifies the cake-cutting. BGM fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a celebratory birthday surprise for a friend, emphasizing emotional connection, humor, and the spontaneous joy of friendship.
